Sam (ACME Corp): Hey team - after the 03/26 rollout we started seeing our automations fail. The model no longer triggers our external tool call; instead it prints a suggestion like 'You could call get_account_balance' in plain text. This used to call the function with correct JSON args.

maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this, Sam. Can you paste a minimal request + response (no PII) and a request-id if you have one?

Sam (ACME Corp): Request-id: rwd-req-8b7f2c. Minimal curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SK_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-prod-v3.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"what's the balance for acct 12345"}],"functions":[{"name":"get_account_balance","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_id":{"type":"integer"}}}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```
Response body (truncated):
```
{ "id":"resp-99","model":"rwd-prod-v3.1","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"You can call get_account_balance with account_id 12345","function_call":null}}]}
```

maya (support): Thanks. So the assistant message has function_call null even though before rollout it returned {"name":"get_account_balance","arguments":"{\"account_id\":12345}"}. Are you seeing this consistently or intermittently?

Sam (ACME Corp): ~90% of calls after 03/26. Before that it was >99% success. We tried forcing function_call: {"name":"get_account_balance"} and the model still returns text rather than executing.

kevin (support): @liam / @dina can you triage? Sounds like a function-calling regression tied to the v3.1 rollout. Sam - quick check: did you pin model or are you hitting routed variants?

Sam (ACME Corp): Not pinned. The dashboard shows requests hitting rwd-prod-v3.1 and rwd-prod-v3.1-quant.

liam (eng-runtime): Looking. Initial hypothesis: adapter change in the function-calling pipeline that upgrades to structured output schema; some quantized backends returned a tokenization-escaped sequence that our function-call detector failed to parse.

liam (eng-runtime): Can you share the raw token stream or enable debug header? If you include header X-Debug-Request: true we can fetch the server-side parse logs for that request-id.

Sam (ACME Corp): Enabled. New request id rwd-req-8b7f2c-2 (same input).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of rwd-prod-v3.1 completed at 2026-03-26T02:10:12Z to 45% capacity.

dina (ml): I dug into the infra trace. For quantized variant rwd-prod-v3.1-quant, the runtime was emitting function_call tokens but they were being post-processed with a JSON sanitizer that replaced escaped quotes with plain quotes, which when combined with our strict parser produced a null function_call and left only assistant content. Root cause: sanitizer assumed top-level string body rather than nested JSON string.

dina (ml): Repro steps I used:
1) curl with model set to the -quant variant
2) look at server token stream: shows sequence "function_call": "{\\\"name\\\": \\\"get_account_balance\\\", \\\"arguments\\\": \\\"{\\\\\\\"account_id\\\\\\\":12345}\\\"}"
3) sanitizer ran and post-processed into "function_call": null in the final parsed message object.

maya (support): Thanks Dina. Sam - we can either rollback the canary or push the sanitizer hotfix. Which do you prefer for immediate mitigation?

Sam (ACME Corp): Rollback is fine. We're blocked on nightly batch jobs.

kevin (support): Initiating rollback for 45% canary -> 0%. @deploy-bot can you run rollback?

deploy-bot: Rolling back rwd-prod-v3.1 canary from 45% to 0%. Started at 2026-03-26T03:00:05Z.

dina (ml): I'll prepare a patch to the sanitizer to preserve escaped nested JSON strings in function_call values and add unit tests. Workaround: pin to rwd-prod-v3.0 until patch lands.

liam (eng-runtime): Confirming we saw request success rates for function-calls go back up to baseline after rollback in our metrics. Sam, can you validate your jobs after a few runs?

Sam (ACME Corp): Ran one batch - looks good, function calls are firing. Will monitor overnight and report if anything else. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

maya (support): Follow-ups:
- Action: Dina to submit patch PR referencing ticket #INC-4821.
- Action: Liam to broaden integration test to include quantized variant token stream.
- Action: Support to reach out to affected customers with note and rollback ETA.

dina (ml): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6723 - patch includes sanitizer fix + unit tests + a new regression test that simulates nested-quoted function_call arguments.

liam (eng-runtime): We'll schedule a canary re-deploy only after QA verifies tests: target 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC canary to 10% then monitor.

kevin (support): Sam - I'll keep this thread updated. If anything flares up please ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Sam (ACME Corp): Appreciate it. Tagging support contact here: julia@acme.com in case anything else comes up.

maya (support): Closing loop once 24h stable. Marking as incident INC-4821 in tracker.

kevin (support): Incident notes (short): regression after 03/26 canary; root cause sanitizer mishandled nested JSON in function_call for quantized variant; rollback to 0% resolved; patch PR #6723 open; planned canary re-deploy 03/27 10:00 UTC to 10%.

Sam (ACME Corp): Confirmed stable after 24h. Thanks again.
